svg.title: Session tree from PID 1 down
svg.desc: systemd at the top spawns two paths: a virtual console session where agetty, login, and bash share one PID with controlling terminal tty1, and a desktop session with no controlling terminal containing systemd --user, GUI apps, and a terminal emulator, which in turn spawns a new shell session with controlling terminal /dev/pts/0.
svg.text: Amber = session with a controlling tty
